in_sanskrit.name: Roushan
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Mountain of Strength
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Roushan एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Rush' meaning 'mountain' and 'An' meaning 'strength'. This name signifies a person of great strength and resilience, like a mountain that stands firm against the elements.
